title: feat: package delete via --name
description:
## Description

Adds the ability to delete a package with --name and --version. Removing the need to do a separate call via package list with jq filtering

## Related Issues

Resolves #8579

## How has this been tested?

* Tested via `go test`
* used it in my own gitlab project to remove a file by `--name and --version` (generic type)
  * re-runs failed to find package as expected
